sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which action do we usually do while singing a lively folk song?
What kind of sound does a pair of cymbals make when struck together?
Which body part is mostly used for stamping in a dance?
How do we show sadness through our face in a dance performance?
What happens when you hit a drum harder?
options: D) It plays a sweet melody

questions.question_text: What are 'Mudras' in Indian classical dance?
Which type of dance is usually performed in a group during harvest festivals?
If you are drawing a person running fast, how should their legs look?
A lullaby is a special song meant to help a baby do what?
When dancers move together holding hands in a circle, what pattern do they make?
Name two musical instruments you blow into and describe their sounds. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A flute makes a sweet, high-pitched whistling sound. A trumpet makes a loud, bold, and brassy sound when you blow into it strongly.

questions.question_text: Why is good posture important while performing a dance? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Good posture keeps a dancer balanced and prevents injuries. It also makes the dance movements look graceful, clear, and more beautiful to the audience.

questions.question_text: How can a dancer express happiness without using any words? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A dancer can express happiness by smiling brightly, keeping their eyes wide open, making energetic leaps, and using fast, joyful movements with their arms.

questions.question_text: What is the main difference between a sad song and a happy song? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A sad song usually has a slow tempo and soft, low sounds. A happy song has a fast tempo, upbeat rhythm, and bright, loud sounds.

questions.question_text: Name three things in nature that have a rough texture. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Three things in nature with a rough texture are the thick bark of a tree, the surface of a dry rock, and a spiky pinecone.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are dancing to tell the story of a small seed growing into a big tree. Describe your movements. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would start by curling up tightly on the floor like a tiny seed. Slowly, I would stretch my arms up to show a small plant sprouting. Finally, I would stand tall and sway my arms broadly like branches blowing in a gentle breeze.

questions.question_text: Imagine you invented a new musical instrument made from things in your kitchen. Describe what it looks like and how you play it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: My instrument is made of metal bowls and glass jars filled with water. It looks like a shiny staircase. I play it by tapping the sides gently with wooden spoons, creating magical, tinkling sounds that get higher as the water level goes down.

questions.question_text: Describe the steps and expressions you would use to perform a lively folk dance celebrating a good harvest. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would wear bright clothes and keep a huge, joyful smile on my face. My steps would be energetic, including high jumps and fast spins. I would clap my hands loudly to the fast drum beats and link arms with my friends, moving in a large, happy circle together.

questions.question_text: How would you act out a scene where you are a brave warrior going on an adventure? Mention your face and body movements. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would stand up very straight with my chest puffed out to show courage. My face would have a serious, determined look, with focused eyes. I would march forward with strong, heavy steps, pretending to hold a heavy shield, showing that I am completely ready for any upcoming challenge.
